SET local check_function_bodies = off;

CREATE EXTENSION "pg_cron";

CREATE SEQUENCE "public"."words_id_seq" AS integer INCREMENT BY 1 MINVALUE 1 MAXVALUE 2147483647 START WITH 1 CACHE 1 NO CYCLE;

CREATE TABLE "public"."flagged_users" (
  "id"                 bigint                   GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY NOT NULL,
  "user_id"            uuid                     NOT NULL,
  "draw_date"          date                     NOT NULL,
  "reason"             text                     NOT NULL,
  "fast_gap_words"     integer                  NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  "low_variance_words" integer                  NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  "created_at"         timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  "notified_at"        timestamp with time zone,
  CONSTRAINT "flagged_users_pkey" PRIMARY KEY (id),
  CONSTRAINT "flagged_users_user_draw_unique" UNIQUE (user_id, draw_date)
);

ALTER TABLE "public"."flagged_users"
  ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;

CREATE TABLE "public"."guesses" (
  "id"             uuid                     NOT NULL DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  "word_result_id" uuid                     NOT NULL,
  "guess"          text                     NOT NULL,
  "feedback"       jsonb                    NOT NULL,
  "created_at"     timestamp with time zone DEFAULT now(),
  CONSTRAINT "guesses_pkey" PRIMARY KEY (id)
);

ALTER TABLE "public"."guesses"
  ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;

CREATE TABLE "public"."users" (
  "id"              uuid                     NOT NULL DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  "intra_id"        integer                  NOT NULL,
  "login"           text                     NOT NULL,
  "display_name"    text,
  "avatar_url"      text,
  "created_at"      timestamp with time zone DEFAULT now(),
  "privacy_enabled" boolean                  NOT NULL DEFAULT true,
  CONSTRAINT "users_intra_id_key" UNIQUE (intra_id),
  CONSTRAINT "users_login_key" UNIQUE (LOGIN),
  CONSTRAINT "users_pkey" PRIMARY KEY (id)
);

ALTER TABLE "public"."users"
  ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;

CREATE TABLE "public"."word_results" (
  "id"         uuid                     NOT NULL DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  "user_id"    uuid                     NOT NULL,
  "word_id"    integer                  NOT NULL,
  "status"     text                     DEFAULT 'in_progress'::text,
  "nb_tries"   integer                  DEFAULT 0,
  "started_at" timestamp with time zone DEFAULT now(),
  "solved_at"  timestamp with time zone,
  CONSTRAINT "word_results_pkey" PRIMARY KEY (id),
  CONSTRAINT "word_results_status_check" CHECK ((status = ANY (ARRAY['in_progress'::text, 'solved'::text, 'failed'::text]))),
  CONSTRAINT "word_results_user_id_word_id_key" UNIQUE (user_id, word_id)
);

ALTER TABLE "public"."word_results"
  ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;

CREATE TABLE "public"."words" (
  "id"          integer NOT NULL DEFAULT nextval('public.words_id_seq'::regclass),
  "order_index" integer NOT NULL,
  "answer"      text    NOT NULL,
  "length"      integer NOT NULL,
  "draw_date"   date    NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT "words_pkey" PRIMARY KEY (id)
);

ALTER TABLE "public"."words"
  ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;

ALTER TABLE "public"."word_results"
  ADD COLUMN "time_seconds" numeric GENERATED ALWAYS AS (EXTRACT(epoch FROM (solved_at - started_at))) STORED;

ALTER SEQUENCE "public"."words_id_seq" OWNED BY "public"."words"."id";

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.leaderboard_period (
  p_from           date    DEFAULT NULL::date,
  p_to             date    DEFAULT NULL::date,
  p_min_days       integer DEFAULT 15,
  p_try_penalty    numeric DEFAULT 20,
  p_longevity_max  numeric DEFAULT 0.10,
  p_longevity_days integer DEFAULT NULL::integer,
  p_fail_weight    numeric DEFAULT 3,
  p_today          date    DEFAULT ((now() AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Berlin'::text))::date
)
  RETURNS TABLE (
    user_id       uuid,
    login         text,
    display_name  text,
    avatar_url    text,
    days_complete integer,
    words_started integer,
    words_solved  integer,
    solve_rate    numeric,
    avg_tries     numeric,
    median_time   numeric,
    median_cost   numeric,
    score         numeric,
    qualified     boolean
  )
  LANGUAGE sql
  STABLE
  AS $function$
  with day_totals as (
    select draw_date, count(*) as total
    from words
    where (p_from is null or draw_date >= p_from)
      and (p_to is null or draw_date <= p_to)
    group by draw_date
  ),
  complete_days as (
    select wr.user_id, w.draw_date
    from word_results wr
    join words w on w.id = wr.word_id
    join day_totals dt on dt.draw_date = w.draw_date
    where wr.nb_tries > 0
      and not exists (
        select 1 from flagged_users f
        where f.user_id = wr.user_id and f.draw_date = w.draw_date
      )
    group by wr.user_id, w.draw_date, dt.total
    having count(*) = dt.total
  ),
  agg as (
    select cd.user_id,
      count(distinct cd.draw_date)::int as days_complete,
      count(*)::int as words_started,
      count(*) filter (where wr.status = 'solved')::int as words_solved,
      avg(wr.nb_tries) filter (where wr.status = 'solved') as avg_tries,
      percentile_cont(0.5) within group (order by wr.time_seconds)
        filter (where wr.status = 'solved') as median_time,
      percentile_cont(0.5) within group (
        order by coalesce(wr.time_seconds, 0) + (wr.nb_tries - 1) * p_try_penalty)
        filter (where wr.status = 'solved') as median_cost
    from complete_days cd
    join words w on w.draw_date = cd.draw_date
    join word_results wr on wr.word_id = w.id and wr.user_id = cd.user_id
    where wr.nb_tries > 0
      and not (wr.status = 'in_progress' and w.draw_date >= p_today)
    group by cd.user_id
  )
  select u.id, u.login, u.display_name, u.avatar_url,
         a.days_complete, a.words_started, a.words_solved,
         round(100.0 * a.words_solved / a.words_started, 1),
         round(a.avg_tries, 2),
         round(a.median_time::numeric, 1),
         round(a.median_cost::numeric, 1),
         round(
           a.median_cost::numeric
           * (1 + p_fail_weight * (a.words_started - a.words_solved)::numeric / a.words_started)
           * (1 - p_longevity_max
                * least(a.days_complete::numeric
                        / coalesce(p_longevity_days, (select count(*) from day_totals)), 1))
         , 1),
         (a.days_complete >= p_min_days)
  from agg a join users u on u.id = a.user_id
$function$;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.rls_auto_enable()
  RETURNS event_trigger
  LANGUAGE plpgsql
  SECURITY DEFINER
  SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
  AS $function$
DECLARE
  cmd record;
BEGIN
  FOR cmd IN
    SELECT *
    FROM pg_event_trigger_ddl_commands()
    WHERE command_tag IN ('CREATE TABLE', 'CREATE TABLE AS', 'SELECT INTO')
      AND object_type IN ('table','partitioned table')
  LOOP
     IF cmd.schema_name IS NOT NULL AND cmd.schema_name IN ('public') AND cmd.schema_name NOT IN ('pg_catalog','information_schema') AND cmd.schema_name NOT LIKE 'pg_toast%' AND cmd.schema_name NOT LIKE 'pg_temp%' THEN
      BEGIN
        EXECUTE format('alter table if exists %s enable row level security', cmd.object_identity);
        RAISE LOG 'rls_auto_enable: enabled RLS on %', cmd.object_identity;
      EXCEPTION
        WHEN OTHERS THEN
          RAISE LOG 'rls_auto_enable: failed to enable RLS on %', cmd.object_identity;
      END;
     ELSE
        RAISE LOG 'rls_auto_enable: skip % (either system schema or not in enforced list: %.)', cmd.object_identity, cmd.schema_name;
     END IF;
  END LOOP;
END;
$function$;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.submit_guess (
  p_user_id   uuid,
  p_word_id   integer,
  p_guess     text,
  p_feedback  jsonb,
  p_is_win    boolean,
  p_max_tries integer
)
  RETURNS public.word_results
  LANGUAGE plpgsql
  AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_result      word_results;
  v_nb_tries    int;
  v_out_of_tries boolean;
BEGIN
  INSERT INTO word_results (user_id, word_id, status)
  VALUES (p_user_id, p_word_id, 'in_progress')
  ON CONFLICT (user_id, word_id) DO NOTHING;

  SELECT * INTO v_result
  FROM word_results
  WHERE user_id = p_user_id AND word_id = p_word_id
  FOR UPDATE;

  IF v_result.status <> 'in_progress' THEN
    RETURN v_result;
  END IF;

  v_nb_tries := v_result.nb_tries + 1;
  v_out_of_tries := (NOT p_is_win) AND v_nb_tries >= p_max_tries;

  INSERT INTO guesses (word_result_id, guess, feedback)
  VALUES (v_result.id, p_guess, p_feedback);

  UPDATE word_results
  SET nb_tries   = v_nb_tries,
      started_at = COALESCE(started_at, CASE WHEN v_result.nb_tries = 0 THEN now() END),
      status     = CASE WHEN p_is_win THEN 'solved'
                         WHEN v_out_of_tries THEN 'failed'
                         ELSE status END,
      solved_at  = CASE WHEN p_is_win OR v_out_of_tries THEN now() ELSE solved_at END
  WHERE id = v_result.id
  RETURNING * INTO v_result;

  RETURN v_result;
END;
$function$;

ALTER TABLE "public"."flagged_users"
  ADD CONSTRAINT "flagged_users_user_id_draw_date_key" UNIQUE (user_id, draw_date);

ALTER TABLE "public"."flagged_users"
  ADD CONSTRAINT "flagged_users_user_id_fkey" FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES public.users(id);

ALTER TABLE "public"."guesses"
  ADD CONSTRAINT "guesses_word_result_id_fkey" FOREIGN KEY (word_result_id) REFERENCES public.word_results(id);

ALTER TABLE "public"."word_results"
  ADD CONSTRAINT "word_results_user_id_fkey" FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES public.users(id);

ALTER TABLE "public"."word_results"
  ADD CONSTRAINT "word_results_user_word_unique" UNIQUE (user_id, word_id);

ALTER TABLE "public"."word_results"
  ADD CONSTRAINT "word_results_word_id_fkey" FOREIGN KEY (word_id) REFERENCES public.words(id);

CREATE VIEW "public"."leaderboard" WITH (security_invoker=on) AS  WITH active_users AS (
         SELECT DISTINCT wr_1.user_id,
            w_1.draw_date
           FROM (public.word_results wr_1
             JOIN public.words w_1 ON ((w_1.id = wr_1.word_id)))
          WHERE ((wr_1.status = ANY (ARRAY['solved'::text, 'failed'::text])) AND (NOT (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
                   FROM public.flagged_users f
                  WHERE ((f.user_id = wr_1.user_id) AND (f.draw_date = w_1.draw_date))))))
        )
 SELECT u.id AS user_id,
    u.login,
    u.avatar_url,
    u.privacy_enabled,
    au.draw_date,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE (wr.status = 'solved'::text)) AS words_found,
    COALESCE(sum(wr.time_seconds) FILTER (WHERE (wr.status = ANY (ARRAY['solved'::text, 'failed'::text]))), (0)::numeric) AS total_time,
    COALESCE(sum(wr.nb_tries) FILTER (WHERE (wr.status = ANY (ARRAY['solved'::text, 'failed'::text]))), (0)::bigint) AS total_tries,
    array_agg(COALESCE(wr.status, 'not_started'::text) ORDER BY w.order_index) AS word_statuses
   FROM (((active_users au
     JOIN public.users u ON ((u.id = au.user_id)))
     JOIN public.words w ON ((w.draw_date = au.draw_date)))
     LEFT JOIN public.word_results wr ON (((wr.user_id = u.id) AND (wr.word_id = w.id))))
  GROUP BY u.id, u.login, u.avatar_url, u.privacy_enabled, au.draw_date
 HAVING (sum(
        CASE
            WHEN (wr.status = ANY (ARRAY['solved'::text, 'failed'::text])) THEN 1
            ELSE 0
        END) > 0);

CREATE INDEX flagged_users_draw_date_idx ON public.flagged_users USING btree (draw_date);

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX words_draw_date_order_index_key ON public.words USING btree (draw_date, order_index);

CREATE EVENT TRIGGER "ensure_rls"
  ON ddl_command_end
  WHEN TAG IN ('CREATE TABLE', 'CREATE TABLE AS', 'SELECT INTO')
  EXECUTE FUNCTION "public"."rls_auto_enable"();

-- Guest mode migration
-- Safe to run before any code change: nothing reads is_guest yet.

-- 1. Guests are real rows in users, flagged, with no 42 identity ---------------
ALTER TABLE public.users ALTER COLUMN intra_id DROP NOT NULL;

ALTER TABLE public.users
  ADD COLUMN is_guest boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false;

-- A guest has no intra_id; a real user always has one.
ALTER TABLE public.users
  ADD CONSTRAINT users_guest_intra_check
  CHECK ((is_guest AND intra_id IS NULL) OR (NOT is_guest AND intra_id IS NOT NULL));

CREATE INDEX users_guest_created_idx ON public.users (created_at) WHERE is_guest;


-- 2. Guests never appear in rankings or podiums --------------------------------
-- The `leaderboard` view feeds the daily ledger and the podium counts in stats.
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW "public"."leaderboard" WITH (security_invoker=on) AS  WITH active_users AS (
         SELECT DISTINCT wr_1.user_id,
            w_1.draw_date
           FROM (public.word_results wr_1
             JOIN public.words w_1 ON ((w_1.id = wr_1.word_id)))
          WHERE ((wr_1.status = ANY (ARRAY['solved'::text, 'failed'::text])) AND (NOT (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
                   FROM public.flagged_users f
                  WHERE ((f.user_id = wr_1.user_id) AND (f.draw_date = w_1.draw_date))))))
        )
 SELECT u.id AS user_id,
    u.login,
    u.avatar_url,
    u.privacy_enabled,
    au.draw_date,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE (wr.status = 'solved'::text)) AS words_found,
    COALESCE(sum(wr.time_seconds) FILTER (WHERE (wr.status = ANY (ARRAY['solved'::text, 'failed'::text]))), (0)::numeric) AS total_time,
    COALESCE(sum(wr.nb_tries) FILTER (WHERE (wr.status = ANY (ARRAY['solved'::text, 'failed'::text]))), (0)::bigint) AS total_tries,
    array_agg(COALESCE(wr.status, 'not_started'::text) ORDER BY w.order_index) AS word_statuses
   FROM (((active_users au
     JOIN public.users u ON ((u.id = au.user_id)))
     JOIN public.words w ON ((w.draw_date = au.draw_date)))
     LEFT JOIN public.word_results wr ON (((wr.user_id = u.id) AND (wr.word_id = w.id))))
  WHERE (NOT u.is_guest)
  GROUP BY u.id, u.login, u.avatar_url, u.privacy_enabled, au.draw_date
 HAVING (sum(
        CASE
            WHEN (wr.status = ANY (ARRAY['solved'::text, 'failed'::text])) THEN 1
            ELSE 0
        END) > 0);

-- Monthly / global rankings: same body as before, one added filter on the last select.
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.leaderboard_period (
  p_from           date    DEFAULT NULL::date,
  p_to             date    DEFAULT NULL::date,
  p_min_days       integer DEFAULT 15,
  p_try_penalty    numeric DEFAULT 20,
  p_longevity_max  numeric DEFAULT 0.10,
  p_longevity_days integer DEFAULT NULL::integer,
  p_fail_weight    numeric DEFAULT 3,
  p_today          date    DEFAULT ((now() AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Berlin'::text))::date
)
  RETURNS TABLE (
    user_id       uuid,
    login         text,
    display_name  text,
    avatar_url    text,
    days_complete integer,
    words_started integer,
    words_solved  integer,
    solve_rate    numeric,
    avg_tries     numeric,
    median_time   numeric,
    median_cost   numeric,
    score         numeric,
    qualified     boolean
  )
  LANGUAGE sql
  STABLE
  AS $function$
  with day_totals as (
    select draw_date, count(*) as total
    from words
    where (p_from is null or draw_date >= p_from)
      and (p_to is null or draw_date <= p_to)
    group by draw_date
  ),
  complete_days as (
    select wr.user_id, w.draw_date
    from word_results wr
    join words w on w.id = wr.word_id
    join day_totals dt on dt.draw_date = w.draw_date
    where wr.nb_tries > 0
      and not exists (
        select 1 from flagged_users f
        where f.user_id = wr.user_id and f.draw_date = w.draw_date
      )
    group by wr.user_id, w.draw_date, dt.total
    having count(*) = dt.total
  ),
  agg as (
    select cd.user_id,
      count(distinct cd.draw_date)::int as days_complete,
      count(*)::int as words_started,
      count(*) filter (where wr.status = 'solved')::int as words_solved,
      avg(wr.nb_tries) filter (where wr.status = 'solved') as avg_tries,
      percentile_cont(0.5) within group (order by wr.time_seconds)
        filter (where wr.status = 'solved') as median_time,
      percentile_cont(0.5) within group (
        order by coalesce(wr.time_seconds, 0) + (wr.nb_tries - 1) * p_try_penalty)
        filter (where wr.status = 'solved') as median_cost
    from complete_days cd
    join words w on w.draw_date = cd.draw_date
    join word_results wr on wr.word_id = w.id and wr.user_id = cd.user_id
    where wr.nb_tries > 0
      and not (wr.status = 'in_progress' and w.draw_date >= p_today)
    group by cd.user_id
  )
  select u.id, u.login, u.display_name, u.avatar_url,
         a.days_complete, a.words_started, a.words_solved,
         round(100.0 * a.words_solved / a.words_started, 1),
         round(a.avg_tries, 2),
         round(a.median_time::numeric, 1),
         round(a.median_cost::numeric, 1),
         round(
           a.median_cost::numeric
           * (1 + p_fail_weight * (a.words_started - a.words_solved)::numeric / a.words_started)
           * (1 - p_longevity_max
                * least(a.days_complete::numeric
                        / coalesce(p_longevity_days, (select count(*) from day_totals)), 1))
         , 1),
         (a.days_complete >= p_min_days)
  from agg a join users u on u.id = a.user_id
  where not u.is_guest
$function$;


-- 3. Purge guests inactive for N days -------------------------------------------
-- No ON DELETE CASCADE in this schema, so children are deleted explicitly.
-- Activity = latest guess; a guest who never played falls back to created_at.
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.purge_inactive_guests (p_days integer DEFAULT 90)
  RETURNS integer
  LANGUAGE plpgsql
  AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_ids   uuid[];
  v_count integer;
BEGIN
  SELECT array_agg(u.id) INTO v_ids
  FROM users u
  WHERE u.is_guest
    AND GREATEST(
          COALESCE(u.created_at, 'epoch'::timestamptz),
          COALESCE((SELECT max(g.created_at)
                    FROM word_results wr
                    JOIN guesses g ON g.word_result_id = wr.id
                    WHERE wr.user_id = u.id), 'epoch'::timestamptz)
        ) < now() - make_interval(days => p_days);

  IF v_ids IS NULL THEN
    RETURN 0;
  END IF;

  DELETE FROM guesses g
    USING word_results wr
    WHERE g.word_result_id = wr.id AND wr.user_id = ANY (v_ids);
  DELETE FROM word_results WHERE user_id = ANY (v_ids);
  DELETE FROM flagged_users WHERE user_id = ANY (v_ids);
  DELETE FROM users WHERE id = ANY (v_ids);

  GET DIAGNOSTICS v_count = ROW_COUNT;
  RETURN v_count;
END;
$function$;

-- Not callable through the public API (PostgREST rpc); only cron / postgres.
REVOKE EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.purge_inactive_guests(integer) FROM PUBLIC, anon, authenticated;

-- Daily at 03:00 UTC (pg_cron runs in UTC).
SELECT cron.schedule(
  'purge-inactive-guests',
  '0 3 * * *',
  $$SELECT public.purge_inactive_guests(90)$$
);
-- Rank users by all played words after applying the complete-day eligibility rule.
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.leaderboard_period (
  p_from           date    DEFAULT NULL::date,
  p_to             date    DEFAULT NULL::date,
  p_min_days       integer DEFAULT 15,
  p_try_penalty    numeric DEFAULT 20,
  p_longevity_max  numeric DEFAULT 0.10,
  p_longevity_days integer DEFAULT NULL::integer,
  p_fail_weight    numeric DEFAULT 3,
  p_today          date    DEFAULT ((now() AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Berlin'::text))::date
)
  RETURNS TABLE (
    user_id       uuid,
    login         text,
    display_name  text,
    avatar_url    text,
    days_complete integer,
    words_started integer,
    words_solved  integer,
    solve_rate    numeric,
    avg_tries     numeric,
    median_time   numeric,
    median_cost   numeric,
    score         numeric,
    qualified     boolean
  )
  LANGUAGE sql
  STABLE
  AS $function$
  with day_totals as (
    select draw_date, count(*) as total
    from words
    where (p_from is null or draw_date >= p_from)
      and (p_to is null or draw_date <= p_to)
    group by draw_date
  ),
  complete_days as (
    select wr.user_id, w.draw_date
    from word_results wr
    join words w on w.id = wr.word_id
    join day_totals dt on dt.draw_date = w.draw_date
    where wr.nb_tries > 0
      and not exists (
        select 1 from flagged_users f
        where f.user_id = wr.user_id and f.draw_date = w.draw_date
      )
    group by wr.user_id, w.draw_date, dt.total
    having count(*) = dt.total
  ),
  complete_day_counts as (
    select user_id, count(*)::int as days_complete
    from complete_days
    group by user_id
  ),
  agg as (
    select cdc.user_id,
      cdc.days_complete,
      count(*)::int as words_started,
      count(*) filter (where wr.status = 'solved')::int as words_solved,
      avg(wr.nb_tries) filter (where wr.status = 'solved') as avg_tries,
      percentile_cont(0.5) within group (order by wr.time_seconds)
        filter (where wr.status = 'solved') as median_time,
      percentile_cont(0.5) within group (
        order by coalesce(wr.time_seconds, 0) + (wr.nb_tries - 1) * p_try_penalty)
        filter (where wr.status = 'solved') as median_cost
    from complete_day_counts cdc
    join word_results wr on wr.user_id = cdc.user_id
    join words w on w.id = wr.word_id
    where wr.nb_tries > 0
      and (p_from is null or w.draw_date >= p_from)
      and (p_to is null or w.draw_date <= p_to)
      and not exists (
        select 1 from flagged_users f
        where f.user_id = wr.user_id and f.draw_date = w.draw_date
      )
      and not (wr.status = 'in_progress' and w.draw_date >= p_today)
    group by cdc.user_id, cdc.days_complete
  )
  select u.id, u.login, u.display_name, u.avatar_url,
         a.days_complete, a.words_started, a.words_solved,
         round(100.0 * a.words_solved / a.words_started, 1),
         round(a.avg_tries, 2),
         round(a.median_time::numeric, 1),
         round(a.median_cost::numeric, 1),
         round(
           a.median_cost::numeric
           * (1 + p_fail_weight * (a.words_started - a.words_solved)::numeric / a.words_started)
           * (1 - p_longevity_max
                * least(a.days_complete::numeric
                        / coalesce(p_longevity_days, (select count(*) from day_totals)), 1))
         , 1),
         (a.days_complete >= p_min_days)
  from agg a join users u on u.id = a.user_id
  where not u.is_guest
$function$;
-- Single source of truth for rankings and stats.
--
-- valid_results = one row per started word (nb_tries > 0), flagged user-days removed.
--   * a word still in_progress on a day BEFORE today (Berlin) is failed: unfinished at midnight.
--     Derived here, no data change, no cron. Today's in_progress stays in_progress.
--   * guests are kept (is_guest exposed): their own Stats page reads this view.
--     Rankings filter them out.
-- Everything below reads valid_results, so the rules live in one place.

-- 1. Base view ---------------------------------------------------------------
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW public.valid_results WITH (security_invoker = on) AS
SELECT wr.id          AS word_result_id,
       wr.user_id,
       u.is_guest,
       w.id           AS word_id,
       w.draw_date,
       w.order_index,
       w.answer,
       wr.nb_tries,
       CASE WHEN wr.status = 'in_progress'
                 AND w.draw_date < ((now() AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Berlin'::text))::date
            THEN 'failed'
            ELSE wr.status
       END            AS status,
       wr.time_seconds
FROM public.word_results wr
JOIN public.words w ON w.id = wr.word_id
JOIN public.users u ON u.id = wr.user_id
WHERE wr.nb_tries > 0
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM public.flagged_users f
    WHERE f.user_id = wr.user_id AND f.draw_date = w.draw_date
  );

-- Backend only (service role).
REVOKE ALL ON public.valid_results FROM anon, authenticated;


-- 2. Daily ledger -------------------------------------------------------------
-- Same columns, same order and types as before (required by CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW).
-- Anyone who started a word that day appears (0/N possible). An abandoned word
-- adds 0 to total_time, as before.
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW public.leaderboard WITH (security_invoker = on) AS
SELECT u.id AS user_id,
       u.login,
       u.avatar_url,
       u.privacy_enabled,
       d.draw_date,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE vr.status = 'solved') AS words_found,
       COALESCE(sum(vr.time_seconds) FILTER (WHERE vr.status = ANY (ARRAY['solved'::text, 'failed'::text])), (0)::numeric) AS total_time,
       COALESCE(sum(vr.nb_tries) FILTER (WHERE vr.status = ANY (ARRAY['solved'::text, 'failed'::text])), (0)::bigint) AS total_tries,
       array_agg(COALESCE(vr.status, 'not_started'::text) ORDER BY w.order_index) AS word_statuses
FROM (SELECT DISTINCT user_id, draw_date FROM public.valid_results) d
JOIN public.users u ON u.id = d.user_id AND NOT u.is_guest
JOIN public.words w ON w.draw_date = d.draw_date
LEFT JOIN public.valid_results vr ON vr.user_id = u.id AND vr.word_id = w.id
GROUP BY u.id, u.login, u.avatar_url, u.privacy_enabled, d.draw_date;


-- 3. Period boards ------------------------------------------------------------
-- Everything is per word. Complete days are used ONLY for `qualified` and the
-- longevity bonus. Today's in_progress words are not counted yet.
-- Signature unchanged; p_today is kept for compatibility and is now unused
-- (the "today" cutoff lives in valid_results).
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.leaderboard_period (
  p_from           date    DEFAULT NULL::date,
  p_to             date    DEFAULT NULL::date,
  p_min_days       integer DEFAULT 15,
  p_try_penalty    numeric DEFAULT 20,
  p_longevity_max  numeric DEFAULT 0.10,
  p_longevity_days integer DEFAULT NULL::integer,
  p_fail_weight    numeric DEFAULT 3,
  p_today          date    DEFAULT ((now() AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Berlin'::text))::date
)
  RETURNS TABLE (
    user_id       uuid,
    login         text,
    display_name  text,
    avatar_url    text,
    days_complete integer,
    words_started integer,
    words_solved  integer,
    solve_rate    numeric,
    avg_tries     numeric,
    median_time   numeric,
    median_cost   numeric,
    score         numeric,
    qualified     boolean
  )
  LANGUAGE sql
  STABLE
  AS $function$
  with day_totals as (
    select draw_date, count(*) as total
    from words
    where (p_from is null or draw_date >= p_from)
      and (p_to is null or draw_date <= p_to)
    group by draw_date
  ),
  complete_days as (
    select vr.user_id, vr.draw_date
    from valid_results vr
    join day_totals dt on dt.draw_date = vr.draw_date
    group by vr.user_id, vr.draw_date, dt.total
    having count(*) = dt.total
  ),
  complete_day_counts as (
    select user_id, count(*)::int as days_complete
    from complete_days
    group by user_id
  ),
  agg as (
    select vr.user_id,
           coalesce(c.days_complete, 0) as days_complete,
           count(*)::int as words_started,
           count(*) filter (where vr.status = 'solved')::int as words_solved,
           avg(vr.nb_tries) filter (where vr.status = 'solved') as avg_tries,
           percentile_cont(0.5) within group (order by vr.time_seconds)
             filter (where vr.status = 'solved') as median_time,
           percentile_cont(0.5) within group (
             order by coalesce(vr.time_seconds, 0) + (vr.nb_tries - 1) * p_try_penalty)
             filter (where vr.status = 'solved') as median_cost
    from valid_results vr
    left join complete_day_counts c on c.user_id = vr.user_id
    where vr.status <> 'in_progress'
      and (p_from is null or vr.draw_date >= p_from)
      and (p_to is null or vr.draw_date <= p_to)
    group by vr.user_id, c.days_complete
  )
  select u.id, u.login, u.display_name, u.avatar_url,
         a.days_complete, a.words_started, a.words_solved,
         round(100.0 * a.words_solved / a.words_started, 1),
         round(a.avg_tries, 2),
         round(a.median_time::numeric, 1),
         round(a.median_cost::numeric, 1),
         round(
           a.median_cost::numeric
           * (1 + p_fail_weight * (a.words_started - a.words_solved)::numeric / a.words_started)
           * (1 - p_longevity_max
                * least(a.days_complete::numeric
                        / coalesce(p_longevity_days, (select count(*) from day_totals)), 1))
         , 1),
         (a.days_complete >= p_min_days)
  from agg a
  join users u on u.id = a.user_id
  where not u.is_guest
$function$;


-- 4. Podium counts --------------------------------------------------------------
-- Ranked over all users on the daily ledger (view `leaderboard`), same order as the UI.
-- Today is included, as before.
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.user_rank_counts (p_user_id uuid)
  RETURNS TABLE (top1 integer, top3 integer, top5 integer)
  LANGUAGE sql
  STABLE
  AS $function$
  SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE r = 1)::int,
         count(*) FILTER (WHERE r <= 3)::int,
         count(*) FILTER (WHERE r <= 5)::int
  FROM (
    SELECT user_id,
           rank() OVER (PARTITION BY draw_date
                        ORDER BY words_found DESC, total_time ASC) AS r
    FROM public.leaderboard
  ) x
  WHERE x.user_id = p_user_id
$function$;

REVOKE EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.user_rank_counts(uuid) FROM PUBLIC, anon, authenticated;
